cbic_dgi_neighbour_mean_probe.feature: X_i = mean of one-hot categories of Delaunay neighbours of i, self EXCLUDED (dgi/preprocess.py:121-130)
cbic_dgi_neighbour_mean_probe.probe: multinomial logistic regression, 5-fold stratified, random_state=0, POI-level

twohop_with_selfloop_note.comment: PyG GATConv default add_self_loops=True; the self-loop DILUTES the own-label channel here rather than adding it, since X_i itself excludes self

cbic_dgi_neighbour_mean_probe.interpretation: One graph-convolution hop over a self-excluding neighbour mean re-admits node i's own label into h_i, because i is a neighbour of its own neighbours. Analytic weight ~0.166 of the mixture at degree 6. Removing ONLY that channel and renormalizing drops macro-F1 from 0.641 to 0.250 at Alabama and 0.653 to 0.315 at Florida, i.e. back to the 1-hop level. The own-label channel, not neighbourhood homophily, carries the difference.

check2hgi_loss_code_defaults.shipped_substrate: v14 = check2hgi_design_k_resln_mae_l0_1, built with --reg-poi-mode delaunay_gcn --encoder resln --mae-poi-lambda 0.3 --anchor-lambda 0.1 (check2hgi.py:477-478); board trains on dk_ovl = v14 embeddings re-windowed (SUBSTRATE_VERSION_MAP.md:19-23)
check2hgi_loss_code_defaults.note: The three-term equation is the canonical objective. The SHIPPED representation adds the two auxiliaries; and mae_poi_lambda=0.3 reconstructs each POI's mean category one-hot (check2hgi/preprocess.py:461-491), while anchor_lambda=0.1 anchors the reg-path POI table to POI2Vec, which is the fclass-level table (reg_poi_aug.py:27-35).
